title: Claude Fable produced a quadratic-query algorithm for a hidden cycle problem
summary: Claude Fable 5.1 designed a solver for CycleUncover, a black-box problem that hides an even cycle in a bitstring fitness function. The solver reconstructs a two-coloring from fitness queries. Lean checked the expected O(n²) query bound, while the paper proves an exponential bound for the classical (1+1) evolutionary algorithm on this problem.
ai_technology: Claude Fable 5.1; staged algorithm design and Lean proof generation

source_review.scope: §5.2/Theorem 5.1, Table 2, Appendices E and F.7 and front matter

evidence.tested: The authors defined the hidden-cycle oracle and supplied a staged formal framework. Their report gives a Lean-checked bound for the generated algorithm and a separate lower-bound argument for the comparator.
evidence.unknown: This result concerns one constructed oracle family. It neither establishes that the bound is optimal nor demonstrates empirical speed or general maximum independent-set efficiency.
evidence.ai_role: Claude Fable proposed the oracle-query solver and produced the formal expected-query proof under the supplied framework.
